maddeler.e:
تغتربوا (form VIII)
# تَغْتَرِبُوا (taḡtaribū) /taɣ.ta.ri.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# تُغْتَرَبُوا (tuḡtarabū) /tuɣ.ta.ra.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
